package main
import ( "fmt" "log" "os"
"github.com/joho/godotenv" )
func main() { err := godotenv.Load() if err != nil { log.Printf("Error loading .env file: %v", err) }
dbHost := os.Getenv("DB_HOST") dbPort := os.Getenv("DB_PORT") dbUser := os.Getenv("DB_USER") dbPassword := os.Getenv("DB_PASSWORD") dbName := os.Getenv("DB_NAME")
fmt.Printf("DB_HOST: '%s'\n", dbHost) fmt.Printf("DB_PORT: '%s'\n", dbPort) fmt.Printf("DB_USER: '%s'\n", dbUser) fmt.Printf("DB_PASSWORD: '%s'\n", dbPassword) fmt.Printf("DB_NAME: '%s'\n", dbName)
dsn := fmt.Sprintf("host=%s user=%s password=%s dbname=%s port=%s sslmode=disable TimeZone=UTC", dbHost, dbUser, dbPassword, dbName, dbPort)
fmt.Printf("DSN: '%s'\n", dsn) }
